svg.title: Off to the palace
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene: in spring, under pink blossom trees, children walk along the path towards the red palace far away, each carrying a pot of flowers — a girl in pink with pink peonies, a boy in orange with yellow chrysanthemums, and a girl in green with red peonies. Last of all comes Ping, holding his blue-and-white pot of bare soil, looking down and sad.
